title: 聖夜に並んで走るため

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and Biwa Hayahide tell me they'd like to go out and train. I decide to accompany them, but…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, we made it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: We're at the summit. It stands to reason there'd be snow here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Listen carefully, Trainer. The reason I came here is because…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to go partner running with Santa's reindeer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I know exactly how you feel. That was the same response I had when I heard her plans.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh? How fast I think Santa's reindeer are? …Given the number of children in the northern hemisphere alone, I'd say they probably travel at close to the speed of light.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoa, is that true?! I wonder what kind of training they did to get that fast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …?! You're not intending to… try and match their ability, are you? It's the speed of light…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course I am. Running alongside Santa and his reindeer sounds really fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …And that's our story.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yep! Don't you think it sounds fun, Trainer?
choice_data_list: (There's not a hint of doubt in her eyes…)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Seeing that look on her face, I realized there was no dissuading her. You know how she is, right?
choice_data_list: All right… Time to run like the reindeer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Okay, the decorations in the log cabin are perfect. Let's see how much speed Oguri can gain now that we've arranged her surroundings to match that of Santa Claus.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ugh… I've only run a little, but it's so difficult keeping my footing on this snow track.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Reindeer legs must be super sturdy to be able to run easily in these conditions.
choice_data_list: That only means you need to train your lower body as well.
That only means you need to train your lower body as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In that case, I have an idea. Come along.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I've built some snowmen along the open pathway. Try to avoid each one as you run through, every firm step you take should build more strength in your legs.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. Plus, I don't want to hurt any of the snowmen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Phew. That training was tougher than I expected… but it was nothing I couldn't handle!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Still, the reindeer have to run while pulling a sleigh along…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Which means I have to follow their example! As for the sleigh… Trainer, could you hop in?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's a fine idea. I'll be your backup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I end up riding in Oguri Cap's sleigh…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer! How am I doing?! Do you think this is good form?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, she's running so fast it's hard to believe she's pulling a sleigh at all. It goes to show how seriously she's taking this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a bit of training, I decide to time her to measure her progress.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… How… did I do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes! I knew training in the snow would pay off!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And also… Ho ho ho, hee, hoo… Yeah. This is what I hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! Next, let's try actually running with Santa's reindeer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now that I feel up to par, I want to put my toughened legs to the test!
choice_data_list: But where will you race them?
But where will you race them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now that I feel up to par, I want to put my toughened legs to the test!
choice_data_list: But where will you race them?
But where will you race them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm. That's a good point… Where do Santa and co. actually live?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well, this hasn't been proven, but it's often said that Santa's "north pole" home is actually in Finland.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So they're overseas… That's a long way away. Plus, they do things differently in races abroad…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll have to do my best in Japan first. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to someday compete against Santa's reindeer, Oguri Cap resolves to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There isn't?
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you build more strength before you face them?
Shouldn't you build more strength before you face them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right! It'd be disrespectful to the reindeer if I didn't race them at my best.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay. First, I'll get stronger, and then I'll challenge them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're already seeing great results, so I expect you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Right! If I keep this up, I'll be able to go partner running with the reindeer before long. Ahhh, how exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a radiant smile on her face, Oguri Cap commits to her training regimen.
